name: NDW traffic speed and flow (Netherlands)
short: Dutch motorway traffic speed and flow per measurement site, refreshed every minute; free CC0 DATEX II files.
summary: NDW, the Dutch national road data partnership, publishes open data files on opendata.ndw.nu. trafficspeed.xml.gz holds current speed and flow per measurement site as DATEX II (SOAP envelope, about 1 MB gzipped); measurement_current.xml.gz holds the site table with coordinates. No key was needed on 2026-11-08.

tasks: current traffic speed on a Dutch road
traffic flow at a measurement site

pricing.notes: NDW terms page: open data is offered under CC0 1.0 unless a dataset says otherwise.

latency.notes: Live check 2026-11-08: Last-Modified 13:22:10 GMT, publicationTime 13:21:42Z at 13:22 GMT.

delivery.basis: Live check 2026-11-08: Last-Modified 13:22:10 GMT, publicationTime 13:21:42Z at 13:22 GMT.

coverage.notes: National road network; sites are matched to coordinates through the separate site table file.

licensing.summary: NDW terms of use page (Gebruiksvoorwaarden Open Data, read in Dutch 2026-11-08): data offered as open data is under Creative Commons Zero (CC0 1.0) unless a specific dataset states otherwise; free use, copying, change and distribution, commercial too; attribution not required. AI training is not specifically addressed.

auth.how_to_get: No key or registration is needed.

endpoints.notes: Current speed and flow per site, DATEX II.
Measurement site table with locations (about 10 MB).

api.rate_limits: None stated on the page read.
api.notes: Gzip DATEX II XML; the first file is served with an XML content type, so decompress yourself if the bytes are gzip.

human.unknown: No person is involved in a reading; the data is machine-generated.

application.unknown: No signing or attestation of the data is described.

camera.unknown: Not a camera source; no image signing applies.

time.unknown: Each file carries a publicationTime; how detector clocks are kept is not stated.

location.unknown: Coordinates are published by the provider; nothing proves a device or station has not moved.

content.unknown: No check of a reading against a second source is described.

corroboration.unknown: No independent review of individual records is described.
